title: Student Resume in India: What to Write When You Have No Work Experience
seoTitle: Student Resume With No Experience: An Indian Guide
seoDescription: Build a student resume with no work experience: projects, internships, NSS/NCC, hackathons, NPTEL courses, campus placement rules and an example.
excerpt: Turn college projects, NSS or NCC, fests, hackathons and NPTEL scores into resume lines, learn how campus placement cells verify resumes, and see a B.Com resume rebuilt step by step.
